cases.sql: CREATE TYPE actual_record AS (n real,t text); CREATE TYPE declared_record AS (n double precision,t text); CREATE TYPE record_source AS (a actual_record); CREATE VIEW record_bytes AS SELECT '("(0.1,one)")'::record_source AS v; ALTER TYPE record_source ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE bytea; CREATE TYPE record_target AS (a bytea)

DO $$ DECLARE r text; BEGIN SELECT ROW((v).a)::text INTO r FROM record_bytes; EXECUTE format('CREATE VIEW record_value AS SELECT %L::record_target AS v',r); END $$; ALTER TYPE record_target ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE declared_record
SELECT (v).a IS NULL AS isnull,pg_typeof((v).a)::text AS ty FROM record_value
SELECT ((v).a=ROW(0.1::double precision,'one')::declared_record)::text AS equal FROM record_value
SELECT ((v).a<ROW(0.1::double precision,'one')::declared_record)::text AS less FROM record_value
CREATE TABLE record_saved(v record_target); INSERT INTO record_saved SELECT v FROM record_value
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX record_saved_key ON record_saved(v)
INSERT INTO record_saved SELECT v FROM record_value
SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM record_saved WHERE v=(SELECT v FROM record_value)
SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM record_saved x WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_saved y WHERE x.v=y.v)
SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM record_saved x WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT v FROM record_saved UNION ALL SELECT v FROM record_saved) y WHERE x.v=y.v)

SELECT (v).a::text AS value,count(*)::text AS n FROM record_saved GROUP BY (v).a
SELECT DISTINCT (v).a::text AS value FROM record_saved
